title: The 5 Best String Trimmers for Small Yards
h1: The 5 Best String Trimmers for Small Yards
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for string trimmers for small yards, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at string trimmers for small yards using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Worx WG183 40V String Trimmer
products.blurb: Key specs: 13-inch dual-exit cutting head, 40V PowerShare, 2 x 2.0Ah batteries included, Under 5 pounds.
strengths: Under 5 pounds, the lightest trimmer in this roundup and easiest to maneuver around small beds
Two included batteries cover a small lot with plenty of runtime to spare
PowerShare batteries cross over to other Worx yard tools if the collection grows
limitations: 13-inch swath would be limiting on anything beyond a small lot
Auto-feed line advance occasionally over-feeds line
Dual-exit head design is less common, replacement line spools can be pricier

products.name: Greenworks 40V 12-Inch Cordless String Trimmer
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-inch cutting swath, 40V lithium battery, 2.0Ah included, Dual line auto-feed.
strengths: Lowest price in this list while still covering small-yard trimming comfortably
12-inch swath is proportionate to tight beds and small lots, not a real limitation at this scale
3-year warranty gives good peace of mind for infrequent use
limitations: 2.0Ah battery has the shortest runtime here, though it's adequate for a small lot
Build quality feels a step below the EGO or Worx
Variable speed trigger takes some practice to modulate smoothly

products.name: EGO Power+ ST1521S 15-Inch String Trimmer
products.blurb: Key specs: 15-inch cutting swath, 56V ARC Lithium battery, 2.5Ah included, Carbon fiber split shaft.
strengths: More cutting swath than strictly needed for a small yard, useful if the yard grows or changes
56V battery shares with EGO mowers, blowers, and other tools if the collection expands
POWERLOAD auto-feed is a genuine convenience even on light, infrequent use
limitations: Heavier and pricier than dedicated compact models on this list
More capacity than a genuinely small lot needs
56V battery platform is its own ecosystem, doesn't cross over to 40V tools
features: Compatible with EGO's broader 56V tool lineup

products.name: Husqvarna 128LD Gas String Trimmer
products.blurb: Key specs: 28cc 2-cycle gas engine, 17-inch cutting swath, Straight shaft.
strengths: No battery runtime limit, though irrelevant at small-yard scale
Useful if you already have other gas equipment and mixed fuel on hand
limitations: Louder and heavier than any cordless model, a real downside in tight residential settings
17-inch swath and engine power are wasted capacity on a small lot
Fuel mixing and carburetor upkeep are unnecessary hassle for light, occasional use

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
